title: OpenAI Moves Toward a $1.25 Trillion Value
text: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow takes a look at OpenAI's potential fundraising at a staggering $1.25 trillion valuation. Plus, Anthropic's looming IPO could deliver blockbuster gains for some of its biggest investors, with billions of dollars on the line. And, SpaceX is taking another step toward becoming a major US wireless carrier, eyeing access to at least 80,000 cell sites nationwide. (Source: Bloomberg)
